48-  fallback: a recorded sample of Newcastle permits).
49-- Gemini paid tier (billing enabled on the key).

51-  the demo uses placeholder links.
52-- Apple developer account and HealthKit entitlement; test Watch signing, stop at hour 2.
53-- Check which Observatory noise sensors reported in the last 24 hours; backfill 30+ nights.

55-## Risks
56-| Risk | Likelihood | Fallback |
57-|---|---|---|
58-| Watch app signing eats hours | High | Stop at hour 2; the phone reads Watch data through HealthKit anyway |
59-| HealthKit entitlement or developer account not ready | Medium | Sort it in hour one; worst case, export Health data from the Health app and import it |
60-| iOS stops recording when locked | Medium | Test on the first evening; fallback is screen-on with Guided Access |
61-| Nobody sleeps near an Observatory sensor | Happened (confirmed 2026-11-14) | The personal night still works; the city map uses sensors near the venue |
62-| Street Manager feed not live in time | Medium | A recorded sample of Newcastle permits |
63-| Observatory sensors stale or API down | Medium | History backfilled into Tiger in hour one; pick sensors that reported in the last 24 hours |
64-| Gemini paid tier not set up | Low | Enable billing in hour one |
65-| Hotel affiliate access not granted | High | OpenStreetMap hotels with placeholder booking links |
66-| Live audio fails in a loud hall | Medium | Speaker held against the phone; backup video |
67-| Judges challenge the causation claim | High | Counts against the random-window baseline; say "linked to", never "caused by" |
68-
69-## Constraints
70-- MLH rules: only work done during the event is judged.
71-- This framework (`hq`, agent rules, docs, GitHub templates) is pre-event tooling, prepared before
72-  DurHack and disclosed in `README.md`. The submission repo is created from it at kick-off and
73-  all product code is written during the event.
74-- Secrets live in `.env` only. Never commit them or paste them into an agent prompt.
